name: embedded-agent-app-r2
title: R2 CanISend MCP and safe review loop
description: R2a effective isolation, Application-bound MCP, and explicit private-context/commit consent; R2b durable audit origin and exact managed-file history
creator: pengjiaxin
notes: Owner-authorized direct execution. Application-bound MCP and the desktop named-permission bootstrap are implemented locally. The Codex 0.152.0 probe has 25 checks on macOS arm64; account recognition passes without credential copying or model turns. Application session binding and registry v3 metadata migration are now implemented. Host-denial notices are implemented; the local probe also reproduces Skill metadata discovery despite the skip flag and excluded read grant. The owner approved separate Codex configuration/login on 2026-09-05 under the amended ADR-RN-0022. Dedicated child directories and provider-owned browser login are implemented; local fixtures prove external Skill/MCP exclusion. The real dedicated browser login timed out after five minutes without a verified sign-in; retry and managed/system configuration qualification remain pending. Complete inherited MCP/host-skill isolation, consent UI/correlation, signed-in flow and durable R2b history/origin remain pending. See implement.md and research/r2a-boundary-evidence.md. Owner changed delivery priority on 2026-09-06: App-first execution is closed as superseded; R0/R1 source retained, partial R2 unaccepted, unfinished R2-R6 deferred. CLI-first work ordering is in the master roadmap. Merge target and protected integration remain pending. Closeout review found the App shell still passes legacy selectedJobId to AgentView instead of selectedV4Application. Resolver/registry/component checks do not prove complete shell-to-v4 binding; retain that as an open deferred R2 gate.
